sources.title: Microduck - ROBOTS: Your Guide to the World of Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a small biped robot with a distinctly ducklike waddle. Using AI skills, it can walk, sit, roller-skate, pick up objects with its beak, recover from falls, and quack in its own voice. Designed for developers, researchers, and robotics enthusiasts, it ships assembled, uses open-source software tools, and offers a playful platform for training, testing, and sharing new behaviors.

sources.title: Buy Microduck: Small robot. Super smart.
sources.snippet: Buy Microduck, the 10 inch bipedal AI robot by Pollen Robotics × Hugging Face, shown by Jensen Huang at NVIDIA GTC Berlin. Official preorders from $399.

sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.

sources.title: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI ...
sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.
